FN-U9IYWGX-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 141
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 141 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain municipal utility boards
by an estimated maximum of $21,600 annually for each board by increasing the cap on director's
fees paid to board members by: 1) $600 per meeting for the board chair; and 2) $200 per
meeting for the board members.
This bill could also increase the obligations of certain other municipal utility boards by an
estimated maximum of $9,600 annually for each board by allowing the municipality respective
to increase board membership from 3 members, currently to 5 members, as provided in this bill.
Page 1
